2.293.5
Style.BackgroundImage
The Style.BackgroundImage element specifies the BackgroundImage for a report item. This
element is optional. If this element is not present, there MUST NOT be a background image for the
report item. The Style.BackgroundImage element is of type BackgroundImage.
Following is the parent element of the Style.BackgroundImage element.
Parent elements
Style
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Style.BackgroundImage element.
 <xsd:element name="BackgroundImage" type="BackgroundImageType" minOccurs="0" />
